question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Despondency
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**despondency**" means low spirits from loss of hope or courage; dejection.(निराशा)

 
 
• **Example**- The soldiers were prone to anorexia, **despondency**, and bouts of weeping.
 
 
 
• **"Cheerfulness" **means a bright, pleasant quality that makes you feel positive and happy.(उल्लास)
 
 
• **Example**- When Macbeth arrives, she urges him to feign **cheerfulness **at the feast.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **despondency **is **cheerfulness**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **cheerfulness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• **Dejection**(उदासी): a sad and depressed state; low spirits.

 
 
• **Example**- He wandered around in a state of utter **dejection.**
 
 
 
• **​**.**Satisfaction(**संतुष्टि):** **fulfilment of one's wishes, expectations, or needs, or the pleasure derived from this.
 
 
• Example- she felt she had done the work to her own **satisfaction**.
 
 
 
• **Hopelessness**(निराशा): the feeling or state of being without hope.
 
 
• **Example**- I did not feel angry, it was more a feeling of **hopelessness**..
